name: Phulbani–Athmallik National Highway
significance: NH 157A is a branch of NH 157. In the national highway numbering used since 2010, a letter after the number marks a spur or link off the main route — this one runs Phulbani to Athmallik, and it meets NH 157 along the way.

relatedRoads.label: NH 157 — the highway this branch takes its number from, running Asika to Athmallik
